properties.description:
Use filesystem contributor capabilities to persist configured engine entities and relations as separate files updated in place. Save is distinct from commit. Detect invalid input and unsaved same-record conflicts; reconcile external changes through engine primitives. Include optional Git history/commit/conflict integration and LFS-aware assets. No domain vocabulary or revision-directory copies.

Implemented in a2a55c52. One entity/relation file per record; engine-predicate selection, guarded batches, same-record conflict resolution, filesystem observation, optional isolated Git commits and on-demand committed snapshots. Non-Git operation is supported. Git uses native filters for configured LFS. Verification: 7 persistence scenarios, 4 filesystem scenarios, package TypeScript compilation, repository organization and full type-safety check. Activity-board adoption and real-data migration are the next task.
properties.title: Implement decentralized graph persistence with optional Git
